navigation.purpose: Georgia section anchors; mobile uses Manrope.

motion.name: gauntlet-entrance
motion.purpose: Single board reveal: opacity 0.8 to 1 and translateY(5px) to 0. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: gauntlet-hover
motion.purpose: Artwork lifts 3px and rotates −2 degrees on hover. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: gauntlet-path
motion.value: 220ms linear per segment, two 1200ms ease-in-out pulses, then a repeating 6s ease-in-out idle pulse
motion.purpose: Reveals to the furthest populated current status, pulses twice, then gently cycles opacity from 1 to 0.72 in place. Excludes Rejected and Unknown. Restarts when endpoint changes; static for reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action with explicit keyboard focus.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Compact transparent field with a visible label.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Search demo records<input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Company or role…"></label>

components.name: Index
components.css: .ds-index{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;background:var(--surface,#f5f1e8);padding:20px}.ds-index a{font:20px Georgia,serif;padding:10px 0 10px 18px;border-left:1px solid transparent;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink,#172d4d)}.ds-index a:hover{border-left-color:var(--accent,#325ec4);color:var(--accent,#325ec4)}.ds-index a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#325ec4);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Hiring Gauntlet checkpoint
components.description: Read-only current status, visible tagline, count and filtered cohort share. Hover lifts artwork; route highlights only up to the furthest populated numbered stage. No click action or tooltip.
components.html: 3AppliedSent. Refreshing inbox is not a strategy.1225% of cohort
components.css: .ds-checkpoint{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:14px 4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#172d4d;font-family:"Manrope Variable",sans-serif}.ds-art{position:relative;width:104px;height:91px;border:1.5px solid #285840;border-radius:50% 50% 45% 45%;background:#fff9eb}.ds-art svg{width:80px;height:64px;margin:10px 10px 0}.ds-step{position:absolute;top:-4px;left:-2px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:23px;height:23px;border:1px solid #285840;border-radius:50%;background:#fff9eb;color:#285840;font-size:11px;font-weight:750}.ds-name{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:750}.ds-checkpoint strong{margin-top:4px;font:30px/1.1 "DM Serif Display",serif}.ds-checkpoint small{margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;color:#52604f}.ds-checkpoint:hover{color:#285840}.ds-checkpoint:hover .ds-art .ds-art{background:#e2ebd7}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-art{transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 180ms ease-out}.ds-checkpoint:hover .ds-art{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(-2deg)}} .ds-tagline{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;text-align:center;color:#52604f;margin:6px 0;max-width:25ch}

narrative.overview: An editorial atlas of a personal job search: paper, navy ink, serif headlines, illustrated Hiring Gauntlet checkpoints with visible taglines, a forest-green route, and a separate muted-red rejection area. Flat, ruled analytical spreads and a fictional application ledger carry the same identity through the entire dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Paper canvas, navy ink, and a cream Hiring Gauntlet board with green route and separate red rejection area.
DM Serif Display headlines and numbers with Manrope controls.
Fixed desktop index and responsive top navigation.
Current-status route, ruled chart spreads, and synthetic ledger.

rules.name: Labeled color
rules.body: Forest green marks the typical route toward Offer, muted red marks the separate Rejected outcome; every checkpoint has an explicit label, count, and share of all filtered opportunities. Offer does not imply acceptance.

rules.name: Flat evidence
rules.body: Use rules and space for analytical sections; reserve shadows for definition popovers.

dos: Do preserve explicit live/demo labeling and denominators.
Do retain chart tables, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep Explorer controls independent of aggregate filters.
donts: Do not imply historical transitions or conversion rates.
Do not position Rejected as the next stage after Offer.
Do not expose private records or replace the synthetic ledger with live rows.
